visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with shoulder-length dark hair, wearing an oversized tan blazer over a short dark skirt and white sneakers, walks towards the driver-side door of a silver-grey Tesla Model Y on a concrete rooftop parking lot at night. The background features a brightly lit city skyline, including the Taipei 101 tower under a dark sky. (2) The camera moves to a close-up of the car's front headlights, which are activated as a single, continuous horizontal bar of bright white LED light spanning the front of the vehicle. The silver paint of the car reflects the surrounding night lights and the camera flashes. (3) The woman walks back to the front of the car, gesturing with her hands towards the new light design while smiling and speaking. She moves her body dynamically to showcase the car's sleek lines under the artificial rooftop lighting and mixed city glow. (4) The camera shifts to the rear of the car, showing a single horizontal red LED taillight strip that glows intensely. The woman points to the 'T' logo above the light strip, which is finished in a glossy black texture against the silver trunk. (5) The shot transitions to the car's interior, showing a dark dashboard with a thin, vibrant pink ambient LED light strip running along the door panel and dash. The woman's reflection is briefly visible in the side mirror as she demonstrates the interior aesthetic. (6) The final scene shows the car parked diagonally on the rooftop with the city lights blurred in the background, creating a high-contrast urban night aesthetic while the front LED bar remains illuminated.
